description:
## New Instagram patches

### Keep screen on while playing video
The screen no longer turns off while a video plays in the feed, stories and other places, like it already does in Reels.

- Instagram only kept the screen on for "video duration + 10 s" (at least about 70 s), so the screen turned off in the middle of a looping video.
- The patch turns on the player's own keep screen on when the video starts and keeps it on for every loop.
- Pausing, scrolling the video off screen or leaving the app release the screen as usual.
- Setting in **Piko settings → Misc → Keep screen on while playing video** (on by default).

### Carousel auto scroll
Feed carousels move to the next item on their own when a video ends.

- If the next item is an image, it stays on screen for 5 s and then the carousel moves on.
- Stops at the last item, when you swipe manually or when the post leaves the screen.
- Only works in feed carousels. Stories and videos outside a carousel are not affected.
- Turned on and off from the post **⋯** menu: **Carousel auto scroll: on/off** (off by default).

## Fixes
- The published `.mpp` now includes `classes.dex`. Before, Morphe Manager on Android loaded 0 patches from this fork's releases.
- The post ⋯ menu click hook now explicitly depends on the decoder. Before, adding a new button to the menu could make patching fail with `MEDIA_ADD_INFO_CLASS_NAME should be initialized before get`.
- `patches-bundle.json` now points to this fork's release. Before, adding this repository as a remote source in Morphe Manager loaded the upstream crimera/piko patches without the new ones.

Tested on Instagram 439.0.0.37.89 (arm64-v8a).
